title: Community resource producer: verified uploads, immutable versions and retention
objective: Implement Community alpha.1 as a runnable independently deployed resource service, with real PostgreSQL/S3-compatible byte verification, ownership/idempotency, immutable versions/licenses, controlled reads/downloads and deletion cleanup. Runtime moderation remains fail-closed pending Q-009.
in_scope: Contract-first alpha.2 correction: declare existing Core profile:read alongside Community write/private-read scopes to resolve active business identity over the public Core API. No new scope invented.
Independent strict NestJS/Prisma/PostgreSQL service and runtime image with explicit migrations
Generate/lock public contract types and validation from Contracts d205a59; no copied public types
Core public API active-identity adapter and verified OIDC user authorization
Signed quarantine upload, byte/SHA/PNG/UV checks and private immutable seal
Resource/version/license/query/pagination/download/unpublish plus persisted audit/idempotency and recoverable cleanup
Moderation application port and disabled fail-closed runtime; explicit synthetic moderation fixture only for tests
Full declared gates, real database/S3 protocol integration and bounded fake-provider state-machine evidence
out_of_scope: Production moderation provider or manual/admin permissions before Q-009/Q-010 decision
F4 social/recommendation/admin surfaces before F2/F3 gates
Official Skin integration/takeover, other repository writes, product pricing or production deployment
Claiming backup expiry/recovery passed without Ops drill or formal license approval
contract_impact: Community alpha.2 prerelease security convergence: existing profile:read becomes explicit in authenticated Community operations because Core /v1/me owns active identity resolution. No alpha.1 producer/consumer or deployment exists; contract must commit and generate before producer. Core/Skin artifacts unchanged.
acceptance_evidence: Real PostgreSQL and S3-compatible HTTP storage prove ownership, concurrency/replay/conflict, upload overwrite isolation, immutability, pagination, fail-closed review, deletion and retryable cleanup
Runtime disabled moderation never publishes; synthetic allow/reject fixture is explicitly test-only
Clean committed milestone records, coordination Finish and local main integration
validation_results: Q-009 clarification remains pending; dependent production/manual-review choices will not be inferred. Other independent F2 engineering authorized by owner and ADR-0014. Core SDK/API contract read-only; S3 tests use a real local S3-compatible protocol server, not a mock storage port.

Implementation exposed a concrete prerequisite: Core getCurrentUser requires profile:read; treating it as an undeclared hidden prerequisite would violate the alpha.1 scope surface. Expanded to Contracts as sole writable supporting repository before any Contract edit; alpha.2 will explicitly declare the existing scope. No other locks overlap.
